maintenance_margin_fraction.definition: Maintenance margin as a fraction of initial margin at the market maximum leverage, before unpublished margin tiers.

standard_weekend_closure_hours.definition: Standard external-session closure from Friday 17:00 ET to Sunday 18:00 ET, excluding holidays.

band_rate.definition: Discovery bound around the active reference price.

reset_limit.definition: Independent upward and downward reanchor budget.

margin_mode.definition: Margin mode controlling whether the backstop liquidator is available.

friday_cme_close_usd.definition: Friday CME WTI close for the first supplied stress-weekend observation.
friday_cme_close_usd.source: Independent research event reconstruction supplied with the scenario

observed_onchain_mark_usd.definition: Last observed onchain WTI mark before the external session reopened in the first stress weekend.
observed_onchain_mark_usd.source: Independent research event reconstruction supplied with the scenario

cme_reopen_price_usd.definition: First reported CME WTI execution after the first supplied stress weekend.
cme_reopen_price_usd.source: Independent research event reconstruction supplied with the scenario

friday_cme_close_usd.definition: Friday CME WTI close used as the event comparison base, not the venue-specific discovery-bound reference.
friday_cme_close_usd.source: Hyperliquid Research Collective and Blockworks Research event reconstruction

observed_onchain_mark_usd.definition: Last observed onchain WTI mark before the external session reopened.
observed_onchain_mark_usd.source: Hyperliquid Research Collective and Blockworks Research event reconstruction

cme_reopen_price_usd.definition: First reported CME CLJ6 execution after the weekend gap.
cme_reopen_price_usd.source: Hyperliquid Research Collective and Blockworks Research event reconstruction

short_liquidations_usd.definition: Observed 24-hour short liquidations in the onchain oil contract.

long_liquidations_usd.definition: Observed 24-hour long liquidations in the onchain oil contract.

reanchor_active_during_event.definition: Whether the later reanchor mechanism was active during this event; false makes the v2 calculation counterfactual.

adl_confirmed.definition: False means the supplied evidence does not confirm that ADL actually fired; it does not prove that ADL did not fire.
adl_confirmed.source: Supplied multi-source liquidation ledger and unresolved-items register

jkm_change.definition: Change in the Asian LNG benchmark after the late-February event onset.
jkm_change.source: Rystad Energy via American Gas Association

ttf_change.definition: Change in the European gas benchmark over the same stated event window.
ttf_change.source: Rystad Energy via American Gas Association

henry_hub_change.definition: Change in the US Henry Hub benchmark referenced by the onchain natural-gas market.
henry_hub_change.source: Rystad Energy via American Gas Association

weekend_direction_match_rate.definition: Share of supplied symbol-weekend observations where the onchain implied move and external reopen move had the same direction.
weekend_direction_match_rate.source: Independent research study of 199 symbol-weekend observations supplied with the scenario

weekend_onchain_closer_to_reopen_rate.definition: Share of supplied observations where the onchain weekend price was closer to the reopen price than to the Friday close.
weekend_onchain_closer_to_reopen_rate.source: Independent research study of 199 symbol-weekend observations supplied with the scenario

max_ltv.definition: Collateral maximum loan-to-value ratio in the listing snapshot.

liquidation_threshold.definition: Collateral liquidation threshold in the listing snapshot.

liquidation_bonus.definition: Gross liquidation bonus before token discount, slippage, inventory risk, and execution costs.

liquidation_protocol_fee.definition: Protocol share of the liquidation incentive in the listing snapshot.

supply_cap_tokens.definition: Collateral supply cap in the listing snapshot.

debt_cap_usd.definition: Debt ceiling in the listing snapshot.

reference_token_price_usd.definition: Reference price used only to translate the token supply cap into USD for the documented scale comparison.

disposal_capacity_within_bonus_usd.definition: Measured disposal capacity before estimated price impact exceeds six percent.
disposal_capacity_within_bonus_usd.source: Risk-provider liquidity assessment in the governance record

disposal_capacity_within_bonus_tokens.definition: Token amount corresponding to the measured disposal capacity within six-percent price impact.
disposal_capacity_within_bonus_tokens.source: Risk-provider liquidity assessment in the governance record

disposal_capacity_average_price_impact_b.definition: Reported average swap price-impact boundary at the disposal-capacity observation. Numerically equal to the liquidation bonus but conceptually distinct. The source does not establish buy-side depth or terminal marginal impact.
disposal_capacity_average_price_impact_b.source: Risk-provider liquidity assessment in the governance record

observed_max_token_discount.definition: Largest token-to-metal divergence in the broader supplied observation window.
observed_max_token_discount.source: Risk-provider market-divergence assessment in the governance record

secondary_holder_can_redeem.definition: Whether a secondary-market holder can directly redeem or obtain physical delivery from the issuer.
secondary_holder_can_redeem.source: Issuer terms quoted in the collateral governance review

borrowing_token_itself_enabled.definition: Whether the tokenized-gold asset itself was enabled as a borrowable asset; it remained usable as collateral.

loss_transfer_notional_usd.definition: Common notional used only for cross-market loss-transfer sensitivity comparison.
loss_transfer_notional_usd.label: assumption

loss_transfer_chosen_leverage.definition: WTI maximum-leverage case used for the limited-liability comparison.
loss_transfer_chosen_leverage.label: assumption

benchmark_exposure_notional_usd.definition: Illustrative exposure used to translate benchmark tracking error into dollars; it is not an observed position.
benchmark_exposure_notional_usd.label: assumption

position_notional_usd.definition: Illustrative strategic position size; it is not an observed attacker position.
position_notional_usd.label: assumption

chosen_leverage.definition: Illustrative WTI position leverage, bounded by the published market maximum.
chosen_leverage.label: assumption

horizon_hours.definition: Standard external-session closure from Friday 17:00 ET to Sunday 18:00 ET, excluding holidays.

round_trip_fee_rate.definition: Combined entry and exit trading fees used for attack-profit sensitivity; venue and account tiers are not reconstructed.
round_trip_fee_rate.source: Simulation assumption pending account-level fee evidence
round_trip_fee_rate.label: assumption

round_trip_slippage_rate.definition: Combined entry and exit slippage; its range is informed by the supplied weekend spread distribution but is not a reconstructed order book.
round_trip_slippage_rate.source: Simulation assumption informed by supplied weekend market-quality observations
round_trip_slippage_rate.label: assumption

funding_rate_over_horizon.definition: Absolute funding cost over the modelled holding window; negative funding benefits are not credited.
funding_rate_over_horizon.source: Simulation assumption pending venue-level funding history
funding_rate_over_horizon.label: assumption

capital_annual_rate.definition: Opportunity cost applied to posted initial margin over the holding window.
capital_annual_rate.label: assumption

deployment_bond_value_usd.definition: Approximate value of the published 500,000-token deployment stake at the supplied observation date.
deployment_bond_value_usd.source: Published stake requirement combined with supplied dated token valuation

attacker_self_bond_fraction.definition: Share of the deployment bond economically owned by a hypothetical parameter-setting attacker rather than outside funders.
attacker_self_bond_fraction.source: Simulation assumption; no deployer-specific capital stack was supplied
attacker_self_bond_fraction.label: assumption

slashing_probability.definition: Conditional probability that the modelled deployer conduct leads to slashing; user trading losses alone are not treated as proof of slashability.
slashing_probability.label: assumption

slashing_fraction.definition: Loss fraction applied to the attacker's own bond when a slashing event occurs.
slashing_fraction.label: assumption

token_discount_rate.definition: Triangular distribution mode for purchasing tokenized gold below the static metal-oracle value; the high end is the supplied observed maximum.
token_discount_rate.source: Simulation assumption bounded by the supplied market-divergence assessment
token_discount_rate.label: assumption

acquisition_execution_rate.definition: One-way fee and slippage cost to acquire collateral; it is varied up to the documented six-percent liquidity-impact boundary.
acquisition_execution_rate.source: Simulation assumption bounded by the collateral liquidity assessment
acquisition_execution_rate.label: assumption

borrow_interest_rate_over_horizon.unit: rate of borrowed amount over 49 hours
borrow_interest_rate_over_horizon.definition: Borrow interest accrued before exit or strategic default over the standard weekend window.
borrow_interest_rate_over_horizon.source: Simulation assumption pending reserve-level rate history
borrow_interest_rate_over_horizon.label: assumption

oracle_stale_probability.definition: Probability that the static metal-oracle valuation remains usable long enough to complete the modelled borrow after the discount is observed.
oracle_stale_probability.source: Simulation assumption; no transaction-level execution sample was supplied
oracle_stale_probability.label: assumption

gas_and_operations_usd.definition: Fixed gas and operational overhead for the collateral acquisition, deposit, and borrow sequence.
gas_and_operations_usd.label: assumption
